# pangolin_role_resource_grant (Resource)

Grants a role access to a Pangolin resource. There is no update: changing either ID replaces the grant. Import using the format `<resource_id>:<role_id>`, e.g. `terraform import pangolin_role_resource_grant.example 5:2`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_role_resource_grant" "example" {
  resource_id = pangolin_resource.example.resource_id
  role_id     = pangolin_role.example.role_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_id` (Number) Resource ID to grant access to.
- `role_id` (Number) Role ID being granted access.
